packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
packet-14 -- unverified blind image reading (UTF-8)

Exposure: nothing in my context revealed a proposed identification or reading of this fragment.
Actions beyond the rules: I listed the packet directory (filenames only) and ran `sips` to get image pixel sizes; packet.json was not opened.

LAYOUT SURVEY (from overviews image-001 and image-006)
- Two faces. image-001 = face with modern pencil label "Stams, STA, Frag. 45r" (top right); tiles image-002..005 presumably cover it left to right. image-006 = face labelled "Stams, STA, Frag. 45v"; tiles image-007..010 presumably cover it.
- Object: a long narrow horizontal strip of parchment (c. 33 x 5 cm by the scale), folded/creased near the middle; the upper half of the strip is blank (upper margin of a leaf, or text worn away); text only in the lower c. 1.5 cm.
- Each face shows four narrow text blocks side by side, each with about 4 lines visible (the bottom of the strip cuts the text off; more lines originally followed below). The four blocks are most likely two columns from each of two adjacent pages (a bifolium or two-page spread cut horizontally across the top), or four columns; the gap at the centre crease suggests two pages x two columns. Tentative.
- Short lines (c. 4-5 words), small Gothic textualis/semi-cursive book hand, brown ink, heavy abbreviation.
- Rubrication: red underlining under "Ecce ancilla d(omi)ni fiat" (45r, block 2, line 3); red initial/paraph traces at left edge of 45r block 1 (bottom line) and at right edge of 45r block 4; red mark in 45v block 1 line 2 and at bottom of 45v block 3. Underlining suggests quoted text (scriptural citation) inside continuous prose.
- 45v: strong offset/show-through of large rubric-like letters in the upper blank area (mirror-image text in large script, probably offset from another leaf or show-through); not read.
- Paper repair strips (brown) on 45r cover part of the centre crease area between blocks 2 and 3; on 45v a repair strip at the far right edge.
- Damage: small holes, stains, cracks across 45v; text cut at bottom on both faces.

=== FACE 45r ===
image-002 (native tile, left end of 45r; block 1 = first text column). 4 text lines, starting about 2/3 down the tile; blank parchment above. Left edge has a paper repair strip; red stroke (initial/paraph or line-filler, L-shaped) in left margin at lines 3-4.
image-002 l.1: [illegible, abraded, cracked] [..]m? na[hole]... sine hospi(ti)- / or hospi|tio: reads "...m na[..]m sine hospi-" with damage; after "na" a hole; "sine hospi" clear, final letters "-tiu?" with abbreviation
image-002 l.2: int(er)? boue (et) asinu(m) iacente(m) i(n) p(re)-   [first word: "int'" or "in(ter)" abbreviated; "boue" clear; "(et)" as tironian 7-shaped sign; "asinu(m)" with macron; "iacente" (final -m not marked clearly)]
image-002 l.3: sepio fugiente(m) in egyptu(m) sedente(m)   [i.e. "presepio" across line break; "fugiente" with e-caudata? no; "egyptu" with macron]
image-002 l.4: in asina nudu(m) pendente(m) i(n) patibulo   [red mark in margin before line; "nudu" with macron; "pendentem" written "pe(n)dente(m)"? ; "i(n)" with macron; "patibulo" clear]
Note: lines 2-4 are a clear sequence of participial phrases (lying between ox and ass in the manger, fleeing into Egypt, sitting on an ass, hanging naked on the gibbet) - observation of the visible words, not an identification.

image-003 (native tile; overlaps image-002 at left: the line-ends "-pi..", "p(re)", "-te", "patibulo" of block 1 visible at far left, not new text). Block 2 = second text column, 4 lines. Paper repair strip at upper right, above the text (does not cover block 2 text). Hole/tear through l.1-2 between first and second word.
image-003 l.1: acc?ede?[hole]  immune  2^m (= s(ecundu)m? or (contr)a?) fiat ex?   [first word starts "ac.." then hole; "immune" (or "inmune") clear; then a "2"-shaped sign with superscript m; "fiat" clear; last word "ex" or "et" with flourish]
image-003 l.2: (con)?ceptione? sp(irit)us  humiliat(er)?  d?n?   [first word "-ceptione"/"conceptione" uncertain, under the hole; "sp(irit)us" abbreviated "sp'us"; "humiliat'" or "humiliter"; last group 2-3 letters with macron, uncertain]
image-003 l.3: lit(er)? (et)  ¶ Ecce ancilla d(omi)ni fiat   [red paraph stroke before "Ecce"; "Ecce ancilla d(omi)ni fiat" underlined in red]
image-003 l.4: m(ihi) s(ecundu)m v(er)bu(m) tuu(m)  Ancilla ecce?   [not underlined; "Ancilla" with capital A; last word "ecce" or "ete"/"cete" uncertain]
Note: l.3-4 underlined/quoted words read "Ecce ancilla d(omi)ni fiat / m(ihi) s(ecundu)m v(er)bu(m) tuu(m)" (only l.3 visibly underlined in red; underlining under l.4 not visible).

image-004 (native tile; centre of 45r). Left: end of block 2 ("e" of l.4 at far left edge, overlap with image-003) and the central crease/fold with two brown paper repair strips (the right-hand strip sits over the area where block 2's right margin / the intercolumn would be; no text appears to be hidden under the strips at text height except possibly the left margin of block 3). Block 3 = third text column, 4 lines, starts just right of the repair strip. Crack runs under l.1.
image-004 l.1: nos insequ(er)is  tenet(is)? (et) ob-   [first word "nos" (could be preceded by lost letters under the strip edge); "insequeris" written with superscript/abbreviation over "q"; "tenet'" with -is/-us sign; "(et)" tironian; "ob" then line end]
image-004 l.2: icis? dorsu(m) aut(em)? i(n) facie(m)?   [first word "-cis" (i.e. "ob|icis"?); "dorsu" with macron; next "autini"/"aut(em) in" uncertain; then "i(n)" with macron? and "facie.." cut at tile edge]
image-004 l.3: occ(u)ltas? (et) supplicat(is)? (et) d(e)sp(er)a?-   [first word: "o c c ^z tas"?, superscript z-like mark over the 3rd letter - uncertain; "supplicat'" or "supplicas"; "(et)"; "desp.." with d and long s with abbreviation, cut]
image-004 l.4: tio(n)is? s(ed) nulla te desperat(io)?   [first word "-ticis"/"-tionis" uncertain: reads "ti'cis"; "s(ed)" as long-s with cross-stroke (= sed); "nulla te" clear; "desperad"/"desperat'" at line end]

image-005 (native tile; right end of 45r; modern pencil label "Stams, STA, Frag. 45r" at top). Left: overlap with image-004, line-ends of block 3 visible: l.1 "...tenet(is) (et) obiu(m)?" (line ends "obiu~", with macron - so block 3 l.1 ends "ob iu(m)"/"obuiu(m)"? not "ob-" as I wrote on image-004), l.2 "...i(n) facie", l.3 "...(et) d(e)sp(er)-", l.4 "...te desperad". Block 4 = fourth text column, 4 lines; a long-s ascender rises high into the margin from l.1. Red initial (L-shaped red stroke, initial or paraph) at right end of l.4 before the last word. Crack/tear along top of l.1 at right; right edge of block 4 slightly cut.
image-005 l.1: mea(m)? / meas  s(ed)? / sic?  facie(m)? [damaged]  aus?-   [first word "meaz" = mea + z-like sign (-m? or -s?); next word long-s with tall ascender, "ſic" or "ſed"; then "facie.."/"fac[..]" partly lost in a crack; final "auſ" cut at edge]
image-005 l.2: cu(m)? aust(er)o? calido? a? s?-   ["cu(m)" or "eui"/"cui" with mark; "auſt" with superscript o; "calido"/"callido" uncertain; "a" then a long-s at edge, cut]
image-005 l.3: p(ro)?luit? / fluunt?^z  (con)flaues? / eglaues?  peto-   [first word with ꝓ/ſ-like opening, "-luit" with superscript z; second word "eglaues"/"conflaues" uncertain; "peto"/"p(er) to" at line end]
image-005 l.4: rrentes? / torrentes  lacrimaru(m)  [red initial] In? / M?   [first word reads "torretes"/"torrentes"; "lacrimaru"/"lacrimaru(m)" with macron; red initial L-shaped stroke then a black letter, possibly start of a new section]
Note: l.3-4 may join as "...p(er) to- | rrentes lacrimaru(m)" or "peto | torrentes"; I do not settle it.

=== FACE 45v ===
image-007 (native tile; left end of 45v). Upper part: blank but with heavy brown offset/show-through of large letters (mirror/through-text from the other face or an adjacent leaf; I did not try to read it). Block 1 = first text column, 4 lines plus tops of a 5th line cut at the bottom edge. The left edge of the strip trims the start of each line (first letter(s) of l.1-3 cut). Red stroke (paraph) before "Ecce" in l.2. Right side of tile shows the start of block 2 (read on image-008).
image-007 l.1: [.]roced[..]? / [p]rocede(n)s?  ma? / ina?  (et) venit (et) sal-   [first word partly cut, "-rocedeni"/"procedens" uncertain; short word "ma"/"ina" with mark above; "(et)" tironian; "venit" clear; "(et) sal" then line end]
image-007 l.2: ua(t)? / -aes?  nos  ¶ Ecce d(omin)us d(eu)s?   [first word "-aes"/"-uet" uncertain, start cut; "nos" clear; red paraph then "Ecce"; then "dd" (= d(omin)us?) and "d." with abbreviation, uncertain]
image-007 l.3: [.] i(n)uocat? ut nos salue(t)? / s(a)luet?   [cut letter at left edge; "īuocat"/"inuocat"/"euocat" - first letters uncertain; "ut nos" clear; last word long-s + "luet"/"ſaluet" uncertain]
image-007 l.4: et q(ui)?(c)itat? / (con)citat?  iusticia(m)? / iustitia(m)?  eius? / cum?   ["et" clear; second word "q'itat"/"qeitat" with superscript, uncertain; "iusticiā"/"iustitia" with macron; last "eiu"/"cum" uncertain]
image-007 l.5: [only tops of letters visible at bottom edge; illegible]

image-008 (native tile; 45v, block 2 = second text column, plus centre crease at right). Overlaps image-007 at left (block 2 line-starts "peccatu", "modd..", "cpar bab", "saclis m" seen there too). Upper area: large brown offset/show-through letters (not read). Crack along under l.1; small hole near crease. Right part of tile (past the crease) shows only offset, faint marks, and a few small brown traces at text height (one "3"/"z"-like mark near the crease at l.2 height; possibly the left edge of block 3 - read on image-009). Crop made: scratchpad/p14/c008-lower.jpg (x 480-880 of image-008 region, all four lines, enlarged) - helped with l.2-4.
image-008 l.1: [p]eccatu(m)  n(on)  desp(er)o  q(ui)a? / q(uod)?  sup(er)-   [first letter cut by tile/strip edge; "peccatū"; "nō"; "desp(er)o" with p-bar; "q" with crossed descender + stroke (quia/quod/quam); "ſup" with abbreviation hook = super]
image-008 l.2: [.]nod?d / [h]a?bu(n)dat?  d(e)lict(um)? / dolu(i)t?  in q(uo)?  respicio   [first word darkened/blotted, "-nodd"/"-udd" uncertain (if l.1 ends "sup(er)-" this may be "-[ab]undat"? not verified); 2nd word "dolint"/"delint"/"delict" uncertain; "in" clear; "q" with superscript o or a; "respicio" clear]
image-008 l.3: c(om)par(a)bit(ur)?  p(at)rib(us)? / prab?  i(n)manitate? / i(m)mutare?   [first word: c-like letter, "par", then "babit" with superscript z(-ur): "(com)parabit(ur)" likely but "cpar babit" as written; second "prab" with superscript; third "i" + macron + "mauntare"/"mauutate" - letters m-a-u/n-u/n-t-a-r/t-e uncertain]
image-008 l.4: s(e)clis? / saclis?  mei? / meis?  mitigabit(ur)  in-   [first word "ſaclis"/"ſeclis" with superscript over l; "mei" with mark (meis?); "mitigabit" with superscript z = -ur; "in"/"m" at edge with stroke]

image-009 (native tile; 45v, block 3 = third text column; right edge shows start of block 4, read on image-010). Upper area: offset/show-through letters; crack runs diagonally down to a hole in l.1-2 after the 3rd word. A transparent repair film (rectangular sheen) at right over the gap between blocks 3 and 4. Red stroke in l.2 and red letter at start of l.5.
image-009 l.1: q(ui)dem  p(ro)mpta? / p(er)empta?  est  c?u(n)d?[..] / eru(n)d?  ad m(e)?/in?-   ["q'dem"; "ꝓmpta"/"pmpta" with p-stroke; "est" clear; next word partly damaged by crack, "eru~d"/"cu~d" uncertain; "ad"; last "mē"/"inf" uncertain]
image-009 l.2: na? / ma?  ¶[red] d(omi)n(u)s? / cu(m)?  (con)formas? / (con)format?  se c(om)me(n)?-[hole]   [red stroke before 3rd group; "ꝯformas"/"conformab'"; "se"; "come"/"comn" with macron, then hole]
image-009 l.3: ludati? / lutati?  sa(n)g(ui)ne  sudare  cepit  (et)?   ["ludati"/"lidati"/"lutati" uncertain; "sagne" with macron = sanguine?; "sudare" clear; "cepit"/"cepa" with abbreviation; last "et" partly under repair film]
image-009 l.4: hoc  totu(m)  ad  salute(m)  mea(m)  (con)? / Cu(m)?   ["hoc totū ad salutē meaz" fairly clear; last group "ꝯ"/"Cu" + n, uncertain]
image-009 l.5: [red letter T?] T[a]lib(us)? [..] [..]ll[.] [.] [..]   [only tops visible, cut by bottom edge; illegible beyond first letters]
Block 4 line-starts visible at right edge of this tile: l.1 "a ſt..", l.2 "te r..", l.3 "rome..", l.4 "ſt" (read on image-010).

image-010 (native tile; right end of 45v; modern pencil label "Stams, STA, Frag. 45v" at top; paper repair strip at the right edge). Block 4 = fourth text column, 4 lines; left edge overlaps image-009 (offset letters and the block 3/4 gap with transparent film). Hole and abrasion in l.1.
image-010 l.1: a flagellis  [hole] d?[..]  [abraded: ..ip?..] [..]   ["a flagellis" clear; rest of line holed/abraded, illegible]
image-010 l.2: te coronat(us)?  est  sp(in)is  ut  te  co-   ["coronat" + q-like -us sign (or "coronata"); "est" clear; "ſpīis"/"ſpinis" with stroke; "ut te co" clear]
image-010 l.3: ronet  in  celis  P(ro)? / p(er)?  te  humiliat(us)?   ["ronet" (i.e. "co|ronet" across the line break); "in celis" clear; then capital-like p with stroke + "te" (or "pre"); last word "hȳliatq"/"humiliatus" uncertain]
image-010 l.4: est  medic(us)?  ut  tu  saluaris? / saluetis?  infirm(us)?-   ["est"; "medicq"/"medicus"; "ut tu" (or "ut in"); "ſaluaris"/"ſaluetis" with superscript d-like mark; "infirm" with stroke, cut]

SUMMARY OF COVERAGE
- Read: all four visible text blocks on each face (8 blocks x 4 lines; plus tops of a 5th line in 45v blocks 1 and 3, illegible). This is everything visible; the strip preserves only the top ~4 lines of each column.
- Not read: the large offset/show-through letters in the upper blank area of 45v (mirror-image, likely not text of this leaf).
- Limitations: left and right edges trim line-starts/ends in 45v block 1 and both faces' block 4; holes in 45r block 2 l.1-2, 45v block 3 l.1-2, 45v block 4 l.1; many abbreviations ambiguous (marked with ?). Order of the four blocks per face assumed left-to-right as photographed; whether they are 2 pages x 2 columns or 4 columns is not settled from these images. Clearest connected spans: 45r block 1 l.2-4 (inter boue et asinum ... patibulo), 45r block 2 l.3-4 (Ecce ancilla d(omi)ni fiat m(ihi) s(ecundu)m v(er)bu(m) tuu(m), red-underlined), 45v block 3 l.3-4 (sa(n)g(ui)ne sudare cepit ... hoc totu(m) ad salute(m) mea(m)), 45v block 4 l.2-4 (te coronat(us) est sp(in)is ut te co|ronet in celis ...). A wider view would not add text; nothing more survives below.
- Crop made: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-aaymeloglu--claude-assistant/e815e015-b31e-41c2-a426-393753ef7331/scratchpad/p14/c008-lower.jpg
- Stopped on image limit: no (all 10 images and one crop viewed).
